explication: Sink is a Cloudflare-hosted link shortener with a dashboard, redirect handling, and access analytics. The principal workflow is creating and managing short links, resolving visits through redirect logic, and turning click context into analytics that the dashboard can query. Separate capabilities include link checking, import/export, real-time event views, and MCP tools. The graph reflects README-documented features and the supplied source excerpts/index; several dashboard and server subsystems are represented at their documented boundaries because their implementation excerpts were not provided.
